svg.title: SIFT enforcement architecture showing how all three harnesses route through the policy gate and bwrap sandbox
svg.desc: Three agent harnesses (Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi) each have hook adapters that call the shared Python gate. The gate evaluates OPA policy, builds bwrap prefix on allow, and returns the rewrite. Commands denied get blocked; commands allowed get wrapped in bubblewrap with evidence read-only.
svg.text: Layer 0 — every bash command, every harness

g.text: parse input → detect source → evaluate → wrap → emit
